title: Borrowing a recorder for fieldwork
instructions: 原创模拟情境，非官方试题；这是独立分科短测，不是40题完整试卷。开始前不看正文、原音、词表或答案。先独立完成8题并保存原始答案，提交后再核对依据。难度是编写目标，尚未经真实考生标定。
transcript:
Student: Hello. I need to borrow a recorder for a college interview project.
Technician: Have you completed the equipment form?
Student: I filled it in online last night. My student number ends in six two one.
Technician: I can see it. You asked for a camera as well.
Student: That was a mistake. We only need sound, not video.
Technician: Fine. The recorder is available from Wednesday. You must return it by four on Friday. We are closed at the weekend.
Student: Does it need batteries?
Technician: It has a rechargeable battery. Charge it with this cable. A full charge lasts about eight hours, but check the battery before every interview. There is a spare memory card in the case.
Student: Can we record in the street?
Technician: You can, but traffic may hide people's voices. Try a quiet room first. Always ask people for permission before you record them.
Student: How can I learn to use it?
Technician: Watch the short training video on the college website. Then make a test recording here before you leave. Headphones are provided so you can check it. If there is a problem later, email the technical team. Do not post the college equipment number on a public forum.

questions.prompt: What equipment does the student actually need?
options: Both a camera and a projector
questions.evidence: We only need sound, not video.
questions.explanation: 申请相机是误填，实际只需录音。

questions.prompt: Which digits are at the end of the student number?
questions.evidence: My student number ends in six two one.
questions.explanation: 按 six、two、one 的顺序选择621。

questions.prompt: From which day is the recorder available? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: The recorder is available from Wednesday.
questions.explanation: Wednesday 是起借日，Friday 是截止归还日。

questions.prompt: By when must the recorder be returned?
questions.evidence: You must return it by four on Friday.
questions.explanation: 周末关门，因此周五四点前还。

options: By a cable that must stay plugged in while recording
questions.explanation: 附线用于充电，未说录音时必须一直插电。

questions.prompt: Why is a quiet room suggested?
options: Traffic could make voices hard to hear.
The memory card cannot be used outside.
answers: Traffic could make voices hard to hear.
questions.explanation: 街访允许，但噪音可能掩盖人声。

questions.prompt: What must happen before recording another person?
options: The equipment number must be posted online.
The person must watch the training video.
questions.evidence: Always ask people for permission before you record them.

questions.prompt: What should the student do before leaving the equipment room?
options: Send an interview to a public forum
Make and listen to a test recording
answers: Make and listen to a test recording
questions.evidence: Then make a test recording here before you leave.
questions.explanation: 提供耳机以检查试录，先当场验证设备。
